name: Rachael Ancheril
bio: Rachael Ancheril is a versatile Canadian screen actress best known for her prominent television roles, most notably as Commander D. Nhan in Star Trek: Discovery and Marlo Cruz in the police drama Rookie Blue. She has built a dynamic career moving seamlessly between science fiction, crime procedurals, and independent cinema.

credits.title: Guarding Stars
credits.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

credits.title: Dreams
credits.overview: A young Latino struggles with immigration, inner city problems and supporting his family, when everything is suddenly torn apart by an innocent mistake.

credits.title: Special Correspondents
credits.overview: A radio journalist and his technician get in over their heads when they hatch a scheme to fake their own kidnapping during a rebel uprising in South America and hide out in New York instead.

credits.title: Siren
credits.overview: Two ambulance paramedics put their lives on the line when a routine call becomes a deadly race against time.

credits.title: Tru Love
credits.overview: A lesbian with commitment issues befriends a widowed mother who is visiting her workaholic daughter.

credits.title: Werewolves: The Dark Survivors
credits.overview: Imagine that werewolves are not mythical monsters, but actually exist. What would the world look like? The answer can be found in Werewolves: The Dark Survivors.

credits.title: Cycle of Fear: There Is No End
credits.overview: What do you fear? One year ago, 14 teenagers went missing. Tabetha is the only known survivor of the group. Found by the side of the road with no memory of who she is and the secret she holds, must find out what's in store for her through clues in her own sketches.

credits.title: American Soldiers
credits.overview: Iraq, 2004: during a routine sortie a US patrol is ambushed and the young soldiers are forced to put their training and skills into action fast. A determined foe with superior local knowledge, the Fedayeen insurgents soon draw them into close quarter combat and a desperate fight for survival.
